HelpOverlay.text: Defense Posts also fire on enemy boats in range.
Click any unclaimed land to place your capital. Solo games deploy 5 seconds after you choose; until then you can move it.

Click neutral land beside you to expand, or a nation you border to attack it. The Attack bar sets the share of troops you send (Q / E, or Shift + wheel). Troops regrow on their own, fastest well below your cap.

Click a coast you can't reach by land and a transport sails from your nearest shore, landing troops for a beachhead. Warships (built from a Port) patrol where you send them: they hit transports first, then warships, then trade ships, which they capture for gold. Below {ws_retreat}% health a warship returns to port and heals near your ports; kills earn it veterancy. Click one of yours, then the sea, to move it.{post_shoot}

Right-click a nation to propose an alliance. Allies can't attack each other and can donate troops. Breaking an alliance brands you a Traitor for {traitor_s} s: everyone knows, and attacks against you cost only {traitor_def}% of the troops and land faster.

Gold flows from your land, factories and trade. Structures get pricier the more you own and need room ({spacing} tiles apart); place them on your own land with the command bar (1 – 7) or the action menu. Land near a Defense Post costs attackers {def_mag}× the troops and {def_cost}× the time.

A Missile Silo lets you launch Atom bombs, Hydrogen bombs and MIRVs. Blasts erase troops and structures and leave fallout: land that stays poisoned until someone re-conquers it, slowly and at a high cost. SAM Launchers shoot down bombs aimed inside their range ({sam_r} tiles); MIRV warheads can't be stopped.
Hold {win}% of the world's land to win (fallout doesn't count). Multiplayer matches end after 40 minutes and the largest nation wins. Lose all your land and you're out.
